<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## Motivation

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->
Fixes https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/43557.

An engine launched in decode mode captures its decode CUDA graphs during `ModelRunner.init_cuda_graphs()`, but that path leaves `decode_cuda_graph_captured` false and `decode_cuda_graph_capture_bs` empty. After a decode → prefill → decode round trip, `ensure_decode_cuda_graphs()` therefore captures another runner instead of reusing the startup graphs. The original v0.5.21 source reproduced CUDA illegal memory access on the first returned-decode workload in two independent concurrent runs.

## Modifications

- Record the captured flag and batch sizes when assigning the startup decode graph runner, matching the bookkeeping already performed by `init_decode_cuda_graph()`.
- Reuse startup graphs on later role switches while retaining deferred capture when startup produced no decode graph.
- Add the regression to the existing `test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_pd_role_switch.py`, covering startup-graph reuse and first capture when no startup graph exists.

@@ -1189,6 +1189,11 @@ def init_cuda_graphs(self, capture_decode_cuda_graph: bool = True):
         self.eager_runner = capture.eager_runner
         self.prefill_cuda_graph_runner = capture.prefill.runner
         self.decode_cuda_graph_runner = capture.decode.runner
+        # Reuse startup decode graphs on a subsequent PD role switch.
+        self.decode_cuda_graph_captured = self.decode_cuda_graph_runner is not None
+        self.decode_cuda_graph_capture_bs = list(
+            getattr(self.decode_cuda_graph_runner, "capture_bs", []) or []
+        )
         self.graph_memory_usage = capture.memory_usage
         self.graph_time_usage = capture.time_usage

@@ -597,5 +597,47 @@ def test_teardown_invokes_release(self):
         s.tree_cache.reset.assert_called_once_with()
 
 
+class TestStartupDecodeGraphReuse(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_switch_reuses_startup_graph_or_captures_when_missing(self):
+        from sglang.srt.managers.tp_worker import TpModelWorker
+        from sglang.srt.model_executor import model_runner as mr
+
+        for graph in (SimpleNamespace(capture_bs=[1, 2, 4]), None):
+            with self.subTest(captured_at_startup=graph is not None):
+                rc.reset_context()
+                try:
+                    rc.get_context().set_server_args(ServerArgs(model_path="dummy"))
+                    runner = mr.ModelRunner.__new__(mr.ModelRunner)
+                    runner.model = MagicMock()
+                    runner.decode_cuda_graph_captured = False
+                    runner.decode_cuda_graph_capture_bs = []
+                    runner.init_decode_cuda_graph = MagicMock()
+                    capture = SimpleNamespace(
+                        eager_runner=MagicMock(),
+                        prefill=SimpleNamespace(runner=None),
+                        decode=SimpleNamespace(runner=graph),
+                        memory_usage=None,
+                        time_usage=None,
+                    )
+                    with (
+                        patch.object(mr, "capture_cuda_graphs", return_value=capture),
+                        patch.object(mr, "prebuild_deepep_v2_buffer"),
+                    ):
+                        runner.init_cuda_graphs()
+                    worker = SimpleNamespace(model_runner=runner)
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        TpModelWorker.get_decode_cuda_graph_bs(worker),
+                        [1, 2, 4] if graph is not None else [],
+                    )
+                    runner.ensure_decode_cuda_graphs()
+                    if graph is not None:
+                        runner.init_decode_cuda_graph.assert_not_called()
+                        self.assertIs(runner.decode_cuda_graph_runner, graph)
+                    else:
+                        runner.init_decode_cuda_graph.assert_called_once_with()
+                finally:
+                    rc.reset_context()
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
